chars.NEIGHBOUR: a 30-year-old French-Moroccan woman with long wavy chestnut hair, natural face without makeup, light freckles, round thin wire glasses, wearing an olive-green military-style shirt jacket over a cream t-shirt and loose khaki cargo trousers
chars.BOY: a 16-year-old Moroccan boy with short curly black hair, wearing a red-and-white horizontally striped polo shirt, blue jeans and white sneakers
chars.SISTER: a 19-year-old Moroccan girl with a long black ponytail, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie and dark blue jeans

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: Seen from the apartment entrance hallway: the NEIGHBOUR opens her apartment door wide with a slightly nervous welcoming smile, gesturing the BOY to come in, head-to-waist framing, faces visible, old Casablanca apartment building landing behind the boy. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, warm afternoon light, no text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n2.png
scenes.scene: Inside a small dining room: the NEIGHBOUR leans over a set table holding a serving dish, asking with a worried, overly careful expression, while the SISTER sits at the table looking up at her surprised; head-to-waist framing, faces visible. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, warm afternoon light, no text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n3.png
scenes.scene: The NEIGHBOUR points at dishes on the table (a tajine, salad, bread, a jug of juice) explaining earnestly with one hand raised as if reassuring, the BOY seated looking at the food a bit amused and awkward; faces visible, medium shot. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, warm afternoon light, no text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n4.png
scenes.scene: The BOY stands in the middle of a strange living room, turning his head slowly with wide curious eyes; around him the walls are covered floor to ceiling with old books, framed vintage photographs, odd masks, antique lamps and piles of vinyl records, dim mysterious atmosphere; full body, face visible, subject centered. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, warm afternoon light, no text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n5.png
scenes.scene: Close view of a cluttered antique shelf full of strange objects: old perfume bottles, a dusty gramophone, faded framed portraits, a folded old woman's shawl, a pair of old reading glasses; the BOY and SISTER in the background staring at it, puzzled and whispering; faces visible. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, warm afternoon light, no text anywhere in the image.

scenes.name: n6.png
scenes.scene: After lunch, the NEIGHBOUR leads the BOY and SISTER down a dim corridor of her apartment, opening a bedroom door; inside, an old-fashioned room with a made bed, an elderly lady's dressing table and an armchair with a knitted blanket, as if someone still lives there; the boy looks uneasy, the sister grips his arm; faces visible, subjects centered. 2D flat illustrated cartoon style, warm afternoon light, no text anywhere in the image.
